text.tspan: Logical UML dependencies · online only · prepared batches optional
Dashed arrow: client depends on supplier. Logical dependencies do not show execution sequence.
D01 Customer QR menu → Visit access and roles: Visit-scoped requests
D02 Waiter POS → Visit access and roles: Waiter requests
D03 Chef kitchen display → Visit access and roles: Chef requests
D04 Cashier bills → Visit access and roles: Cashier requests
D05 Management workspace → Visit access and roles: Manager / stock requests
D06 Visit access and roles → Ordering: Authorized orders
D07 Visit access and roles → Tables and waiter zones: Visits and zones
D08 Visit access and roles → Kitchen operations: Kitchen actions
D15 Ordering → Tables and waiter zones: Validate active visit
D16 Ordering → Menu and availability: Validate dish / price
D18 Ordering → Inventory and suppliers: Reserve / release stock
D19 Ordering → Kitchen operations: Accepted ticket
D20 Ordering → Status and notifications: QR accepted event
D21 Kitchen operations → Inventory and suppliers: Consume / waste
D22 Kitchen operations → Status and notifications: Ready / progress event
D23 Status and notifications → Tables and waiter zones: Resolve current waiter
D24 Status and notifications → Waiter POS: QR / ready alerts
D25 Status and notifications → Customer QR menu: Order progress
D26 Status and notifications → Management workspace: Unassigned-zone fallback
